budgetyourtripProxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Istanbul? Hotel Prices for Istanbul, Turkey | Budget Your Trip
budgetyourtripProxy.evidenceText: 1-star hotels in Istanbul cost an average of $62 per night; median $53; based on 512 hotels. All hotel prices are in US Dollars before taxes and fees.
budgetyourtripProxy.reason: Exact city and 1-star average with explicit before-tax basis; paired BudgetYourTrip snippet reports $147 for two people in a typical double-occupancy room. Retained as a proxy, not a directly observed two-adult 1-star quote.
